name: picture-reveal
title: Picture Reveal
description: A picture under tiles that come away a few at a time while the room guesses. The presenter moves `step`; every screen uncovers the same tiles in the same seeded order, spread across the picture. Phones guess with `TypeAnswer` (or `QuizQuestion`), and…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>

## @interlace/picture-reveal

Installed to `components/ui/games/picture-reveal.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/games/picture-reveal';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/picture-reveal

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
